A. They accumulate in fatty tissues. - This is a known characteristic of halogenated organic compounds and contributes to their toxicity.

B. They are extremely alkaline. - This is not a typical characteristic of halogenated organic compounds.

C. They are highly acidic. - This is not a typical characteristic of halogenated organic compounds.
